introText.mainHeadline: Rustic Holiday Home at Falkert - with Sauna and Relaxation Room
introText.section1Title: Hiking, Skiing & Relaxation in the Nockberge, Carinthia
introText.section1Text: Discover the Sechszirbenhütte, your dream accommodation at 1,700m altitude in the heart of the Nockberge in Carinthia, Austria. Located on the picturesque southern side of the Alps at Falkertsee, our cabin offers a year-round vacation paradise for families and nature lovers.
introText.section2Title: Heidi Alm Mountain Resort: Close to Heaven, Far from Everyday Life
introText.section2Text: Experience an unforgettable vacation at the Heidi Alm Mountain Resort, surrounded by healthy air, crystal-clear mountain water, and colorful nature. Enjoy the alpine flora like gentian, alpine rose, and edelweiss, and with a bit of luck, observe marmots in their natural environment.
introText.section3Title: Winter Vacation at Heidi-Alm: Family Ski Resort & Diverse Activities
introText.section3Text: The family-friendly Heidi-Alm ski resort offers three lifts, a magic carpet, and varied slopes for beginners to advanced skiers. Look forward to relaxed skiing without queues at the lifts, cross-country skiing, ice skating on the lake, or guided snowshoe hikes. At Peter's Ski School, children and adults are patiently and playfully taught skiing and snowboarding. Ski tours and torchlight hikes round off the winter program. Experience the Sechszirbenhütte: Hiking, skiing & relaxation in Carinthia's Nockberge. Book your unforgettable vacation now amidst the breathtaking natural scenery.

ferienhaus.intro: Treat yourself to an unforgettable cabin vacation in our over 250-year-old mountain cabin in secluded location – right at the Nockberge National Park and just 800m from the picturesque Falkertsee.

umgebung.title: Year-Round Vacation Destination for the Whole Family
umgebung.subtitle: Southern Austria: Skiing & Nature Vacation in Perfect Climate
umgebung.intro: Discover the idyllic ski village of Falkertsee in southern Austria, where ski and nature enthusiasts find perfect climate conditions. Experience from December to April dream-like snow conditions and in summer lush green meadows in Carinthia's highest ski village.

central.title: Sechszirbenhütte: Central Accommodation for All Activities
central.description: The Sechszirbenhütte is the ideal accommodation for your vacation in Falkertsee. Thanks to its central location, you have easy access to all ski areas, hiking trails, the Nockberge National Park, and the picturesque Carinthian lakes.

nationalpark.title: Nockberge National Park & Adjacent Ski Areas
nationalpark.description: Explore the impressive Nockberge National Park in close proximity to the Sechszirbenhütte. Also benefit from the proximity to the excellent ski areas of Turracher Höhe and Bad Kleinkirchheim for even more variety.

dreilaendereck.title: Three-Country Corner: Italy, Slovenia & Austria
dreilaendereck.description: The central location of the Sechszirbenhütte allows you to conveniently explore the three-country corner of Italy, Slovenia, and Austria and discover the cultural highlights of the region.

activities.title: Year-Round Activities for the Whole Family
activities.description: No matter the season, there are numerous activities for the whole family around the Sechszirbenhütte. Experience unforgettable moments skiing, hiking, golfing, or visiting the picturesque Carinthian lakes.

heidiAlm.title: Heidi-Alm, Golfing, Hiking & More
heidiAlm.description: Explore the diverse mountain world around the Sechszirbenhütte or use the golf opportunities (18-hole) in Bad Kleinkirchheim. The famous Heidi-Alm especially attracts young visitors to the mountain.

kaerntenCard.title: Save with the Kärnten Card
kaerntenCard.description: Learn about the attractive Kärnten Card, with which you can save a lot of money during your stay. Especially great for families – it usually pays for itself after the 2nd gondola ride.

dogTrips.title: The 5 Most Beautiful Trips with Dogs in Carinthia

trips.title: Falkert and Falkertsee
trips.description: A walk around the Falkertsee is a fixed part of our stay on the mountain and is also manageable for older dogs. A hike to the Falkert is also a must. Depending on fitness, it takes 1 to 3 hours. A steep or moderate ascent and descent are possible. The dog should be mountain-experienced and fit.

trips.title: Hike Rodresnock/Moschelitzen/Marmot Valley
trips.description: An extensive, partly sporty and mostly quite windy circular hike. Our secret favorite – often you don't meet a soul and have the Nockberge to yourself.

trips.title: Three Lakes Hike at Turracher Höhe
trips.description: A moderate hike along the three lakes. Suitable for all levels. Easy to reach by car. Be sure to stop by the Karl-Hütte for Kaiserschmarrn.

trips.title: Panorama Trail Hochrindl
trips.description: Various hiking trails start from here, including a beautiful panorama hike with many fresh water opportunities. Perfect for dogs.

trips.title: Beach Tschinder at Millstätter See
trips.description: If you're looking for a cool-off in summer and want to bring your four-legged friend, head to Beach Tschinder at Millstätter See. There's an area for dogs, of course with leash!

kidsTrips.title: The 7 Most Beautiful Trips with Children in Carinthia

featured.title: Heidi-Alm at Falkert
featured.description: The Heidi-Alm at Falkert is just around the corner and offers a fairytale walk through the Heidi world with views of the surrounding mountains. A large slide and a modern playground complete the excursion. On the lake of the Heidi-Alm, there is also the opportunity to fish. Please contact the Heidi-Alm team in advance. After the Heidi-Alm, you can refuel at the adjacent restaurants Seehütte or Bogi Alm. Adults can enjoy a walk around the Falkertsee.

trips.title: Turracher Höhe and Nocky-Flitzer
trips.description: The Turracher Höhe is a beautiful ski area for beginners and pros. The picturesque landscape between fir trees and mountain peaks, the snow reliability and its 43 kilometers of slopes are perfect for families. Outside the winter season, the Alpine roller coaster Nockyflitzer is an absolute excursion highlight. From 3 years, it's a fast ride down the mountain, of course accompanied by an adult. The Nockyflitzer opens its gates from June. Great playgrounds and Nocky's Alpine Time (a child-friendly discovery hike with stamp card) make the day fly by. No vacation at the Sechszirbenhütte passes without a visit to the Turracher Höhe.

trips.title: Ossiacher See and Familywald
trips.description: Lake Ossiach is about 30 minutes drive from the Sechszirbenhütte. Right next to it is the adventure and climbing forest Familywald. Here, small and big children get their money's worth. The grounds are lovingly designed, there is something to discover in every tree, sound journeys, balance parks, a fly-line and a high ropes course - you can really spend hours here. With the Tree-Net, the Familywald has created an absolute highlight. Here, small and big can walk through the treetops on nets, slide from tree to tree and are absolutely fall-proof.

trips.title: Panorama Trail St. Oswald (with Brunnachbahn)
trips.description: Our standard hike when we're at Falkert. Take the Brunnachbahn in Bad Kleinkirchheim to the Panorama Trail St. Oswald. The hike is kid-friendly and not too steep, perfect for carrying smaller ones in a baby carrier. The view is stunning and there are numerous detours for more extensive hikes if one parent wants to continue alone. Halfway is the Bockhütte, a perfect rest stop and like something out of a picture book. Back at the Brunnachbahn, an Active Park and water playground await you, where tired legs can cool off, children can raft and adults can take a break on the sun loungers.

trips.title: Animal Park Feld am See
trips.description: The Alpine Animal Park Feld am See is a wildlife park at the foot of a mountain. Here you can observe various native animals as well as a small petting zoo. Two playgrounds provide variety. The tour is stroller-friendly, with only a few small inclines.

trips.title: Mountain Railway Gerlitzen-Alpe
trips.description: The Gerlitzen-Alpe is a well-known starting point for paragliders. In good conditions, there's always a lot to marvel at. At the individual stations of the mountain railways (at the top and middle), various playgrounds await. At the very top of the mountain, children can swing with the most wonderful panorama and, thanks to very low gradients, also take a relaxed little hike with their parents.

trips.title: Panorama Road Nockalm
trips.description: The Nockberge have a unique beauty. Like warm green giants, the natural wonders lie in the landscape. They can be especially impressively admired on the Nockalm Panorama Road. Parents optimally plan this around nap time and enjoy the peace and the view. But be careful: it's curvy, weak stomachs might make themselves known.

directions.title: Hiking – Winter Sports – Relaxation: How to Find Us
directions.description: Coming from the Tauern motorway A10, take the exit Spittal/Millstätter See and drive east along the lake to Radenthein. There, at the roundabout at the town exit, take the direction towards Bad Kleinkirchheim. Drive through Bad Kleinkirchheim and after about 2 km at the next intersection turn left towards Turrach and Falkertsee. After about 500 m, a Heidi figure shows the mountain road up (about 8 km) to Falkertsee. In the village you will find signposts with the corresponding house numbers.
directions.note: For car access from November to April, snow chains should be in your luggage.

chapters.title: Outside
chapters.text: The hut stands on its own among Swiss stone pines and larches, right by the Nockberge National Park, 800 m from Lake Falkert. Hike the Nockberge in summer, ski at the Heidi Alm resort in winter.
chapters.alt: The Sechszirbenhütte in summer with balcony and woodpile among spruce trees

chapters.title: Inside
chapters.text: Old wood, a parlour with a pellet stove and a fully equipped kitchen. Two bedrooms – one with a double bed, one with a double and a single bed – sleep up to five, plus two bathrooms and a separate WC.
chapters.alt: Wooden parlour with corner bench and green sofa, a dog lying on the rug

chapters.title: Time for you
chapters.text: The private sauna with relaxation room and sauna terrace is yours alone. In the morning, coffee waits on the large wraparound balcony.
chapters.alt: Coffee cup in the snow on the balcony railing

brand.greetingText: We have set up the Sechszirbenhütte so you can arrive up here and have time for each other. If you have questions about getting here or about the hut, we are happy to help.
